description: The free variables of a substituted scoped term are exactly the union of replacement supports over its original free variables.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.scopedTermSubst_varFinsetLeft.{u, v, u', v'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type u'} {β : Type v'} {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (t : L.Term (α ⊕ Fin n)) (σ : α → L.Term β) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.scopedTermSubst t σ).varFinsetLeft =
    t.varFinsetLeft.biUnion fun a => (σ a).varFinset
